workflow: Newton's third law states that for every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction. This principle can be seen in motion and motion-related forces such as gravity, friction, and momentum. It explains why a ball thrown into the air will eventually come back down, as the force of gravity acts against the momentum of the ball.
